title: Yellow Peppery Mexican Turkey Ham Burrito
description: A flavorful and spicy Mexican dish featuring turkey ham, bhuna, and poblano peppers, wrapped in a large burrito, served in a copper pot. This shojin-friendly meal is perfect for those looking for a peppery and chewy experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the poblano peppers in the oven for 30 minutes, then let them cool and dice them.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat and saute the diced onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the diced turkey ham to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the bhuna sauce to the skillet and stir to combine, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large copper pot, warm the tortillas over low heat for 2 minutes on each side.
Assemble the burritos by spooning the turkey ham mixture onto the center of each tortilla, then topping with roasted poblano peppers, diced yellow pepper, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Fold the bottom edge of each tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the burrito up tightly.
Serve the burritos hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
